Bihar MLC Election Result Political Reaction : bihar vidhan parishad chunav ke natijon ke bad siyasi bayanbaji tej ho gaee hai. RJD ka kahna hai ki logon men sarkar ke prati aakrosh barh raha hai aur iska asar chunavi natijon men bhi dikhaee de raha hai. vahin BJP ka dava hai ki NDA sabhi par bhari hai aur chunavi natije gathbandhan ke paksh men aae hain.
MLC chunav ke parinamon ko lekar RJD aur BJP ke bich rajnitik ghamasan jari hai. is riport men janie donon dalon ka paksh aur chunavi natijon par siyasi pratikriya.
